photos.desc: Una ave llamada ganso del Nilo (Alopochen aegyptiaca), descansando sobre el cesped de los jardines del Palacio Kensington.
The Nile goose or Egyptian goose (Alopochen aegyptiaca) is a species of anseriform bird in the family Anatidae native to Africa, the only one of its genus currently not extinct.
